data.desc: BranchOut Food Inc. (Nasdaq: BOF) is a leading international food technology company specializing in the production of high-quality dehydrated fruit- and vegetable-based products through its proprietary GentleDry technology. This next-generation dehydration method is designed to preserve the nutrition, quality and taste of fresh produce. BranchOut's technology enables the Company to serve branded, ingredient and private-label customers.
